items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: I played a lot with Jimmy when I was at Juilliard. We used to jam a lot.

ctx.x: And Jimmy was, I played a lot with Jimmy when I was at Juilliard. We used to jam a lot. There used to be a lot of jamming going on around town you know, different nights in Harlem, and used to just move around to play. That’s my other life.

It seems to me that bassists have a burden to carry that other — especially horn players — don’t, and that is someone calls a tune and you are the foundation. You’re the harmonic foundation and the time, and if you don’t know the tune who are you going to depend on to get through it? So how do you learn tunes, how did you learn the standards so that you were as prepared as possible?
